editorial_notes: All 154 raw plaintext characters are fixed by valid source coordinates and the complete published key; no source correction is used.
The reader-facing Mel[d]ungen supplies the missing D in raw MELUNGEN. This is an editorial spelling restoration, not a new decrypted character or a coordinate repair.
B.M.K. and NATEKO are retained without an unsupported expansion. ROEM 2 is a literal reference to a Roman numeral, presented without changing the raw digit.
The page heading and internal stamp are 3 November, while the reception header prints 5 November. Both are retained.

editorial_notes: The literal source contains 297 coordinates against declared 296. Its local groups VAAXX VXXAVA contain eleven coordinates.

Deleting either repeated A at original index 211 or 212 gives the same 296-coordinate stream and a largely readable text. The certificate uses index 211 as the canonical representative. This is a conditional source repair, not an OCR omission.
Under that deletion, AN I ETRACHT and LA R E still require two explicit valid-coordinate substitutions to read ANBETRACHT and LAGE.

The exact candidate-cost audit checks every one of the 297 possible one-coordinate deletions. It measures the stated candidate, not all possible German readings; equal best indices 211 and 212 represent one repaired stream.
The cleartext footer WP NF OSM v OUI DD is outside the RICHI ciphertext and is excluded.
